headline.en: Redesigned Quick Launcher Popup & Fixed TikTok Downloaded Videos Failing to Play
headline.zh_CN: Popup 极简快捷启动器重构与修复 TikTok 下载视频无法播放问题

summary.en: Rebuilt the extension popup into a lightweight Quick Launcher aligned with the SidePanel design system, featuring a one-click SidePanel trigger, 2×2 quick actions (Pick Fields, Detect Table, Region Screenshot, Full-Page Shot), and direct workbench jump pills with live media/task badges.
summary.zh_CN: 全新升级扩展弹窗为轻量级快捷启动器，统一 SidePanel 浅色设计系统，提供一键打开侧边栏、2×2 高频快捷动作（点选字段、一键识别表格、区域截图、整页长截图）以及音视频/图片/资产库/任务中心直达分流入口。

title.zh_CN: Popup 极简快捷启动器重构

description.en: Rebuilt the extension popup into a lightweight Quick Launcher aligned with the SidePanel design system, featuring a one-click SidePanel trigger, 2×2 quick actions (Pick Fields, Detect Table, Region Screenshot, Full-Page Shot), and direct workbench jump pills with live media/task badges.
description.zh_CN: 全新升级扩展弹窗为轻量级快捷启动器，统一 SidePanel 浅色设计系统，提供一键打开侧边栏、2×2 高频快捷动作（点选字段、一键识别表格、区域截图、整页长截图）以及音视频/图片/资产库/任务中心直达分流入口。

title.en: Fixed TikTok Downloaded Videos Failing to Play
title.zh_CN: 修复 TikTok 下载视频无法播放问题

description.en: Upgraded MSE track detection to inspect codec parameters so audio-only streams declared under `video/mp4` (such as `mp4a.40.29`) are accurately routed as audio instead of corrupting the video track, and added H.265 / HEVC support to the H.264 compatibility preference mode for smooth playback in Chrome and local players.
description.zh_CN: 优化 MSE 媒体流编解码器（Codec）轨类型识别逻辑，精准区分伪装在 `video/mp4` 容器内的纯音频流（如 `mp4a.40.29`），并将 H.265 / HEVC 纳入 H.264 兼容模式协商范围，确保 TikTok 下载视频在浏览器预览及本地播放器中均可正常播放。
